sources.entry: CAM - macOS camera recording using ffmpeg

summary.one_liner: A minimalist macOS app for recording short camera clips of research participants, saved with auto-generated names for later scoring or analysis.
summary.what_it_does: CAM shows a live camera preview on launch and records only when the red record button is clicked. Users type a name into text fields before recording, and a preview of the generated video filename updates as they type. The preview is hidden during recording so it does not distract participants. Clicking the red square stops recording and saves the video. The app checks for Dropbox and Box folders and saves there first, in that order, unless the cloud option is unchecked in the menu bar. Otherwise it saves to ~/Library/Application Support/CAM/data/. A compiled ffmpeg is bundled with the app.
use_cases: record short tasks with research participants
capture camera video for later behavioral scoring
save named video clips to Dropbox or Box automatically
minimal webcam recording on a Mac for studies
notable: Preview is hidden while recording so participants are not distracted
Auto-generated video filename preview updates as you type
Automatically prefers Dropbox, then Box folders for saving, with an option to turn this off
Bundles a compiled ffmpeg so no separate install is needed
caveats: README has no screenshots and little setup detail beyond npm install and npm start
